showcases.said: It's not easy for me to understand this decision, but I'd say B.

coverage_rest.why: built and approved but with no north-star line of its own; today's only scripted check is its switch write and read-back (validation.py says the behavioural A/B is not built), so its proof stays missing; a raid aimed at a colonist glyph is a long live run for one hook
a switch sweep is a checklist, not a face; each switch is checked off and on in one scripted pass
no ideoligion and a save reload are start conditions of the same scripted pass, nothing a player watches
